title: Talend Failures by Task
app: Talend job execution logs via the Talend Management Console API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=talend:job status="ERROR"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by task_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Talend failures grouped by task so operators immediately see which specific tasks are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Talend is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Talend failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical tasks.
visualization: Table of task by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Talend are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
